Subway-Agent-Lite 1.0.0

- Initial release of a free, basic WhatsApp ordering agent for sandwich shops.
- Supports natural-language orders for 5 core items.
- Integrates ThumbGate safety logic to prevent ordering non-existent items.
- Logs orders directly to Google Sheets.
- Demonstration version with limited feature set.
